title: Berlin Pink Pipes - Quick Summary
items: **Most temporary coloured pipes move pumped groundwater away from a building site.** They let crews work in a dry excavation; the pipe is not a tourist feature or a public route marker.
**Read the setting before the colour.** Temporary supports, barriers and a nearby dig point to site infrastructure. Pink, blue and yellow can all appear in this kind of work.
**Berlin’s inner-city groundwater can be close to the surface.** In parts of the Warsaw-Berlin glacial valley, the city says it is generally expected within three metres of ground level.
**Do not confuse it with Umlauftank 2.** The fixed pink tube in a pink-and-blue building near the Landwehrkanal is a permanent Technical University research facility, not a temporary street pipe.
Use the Berlin Pink Pipe Decoder to make one cautious distinction from the clues you can actually see; it is not a live construction map.
